title: A B cell changes jobs
hook: Predict the interaction and trace one immune step.

knows: The immune system includes cells and signaling molecules.
doesNotKnow: Activated B cells can differentiate into plasma cells that secrete antibodies. Other descendants can become memory B cells.

misconception: The immune response consists of one cell acting alone.
objective: Explain the stated interaction in a simplified immune response.

claims.text: Question, stage and reveal: After appropriate activation, which differentiated B-cell type secretes large amounts of antibody? Activated B cells can differentiate into plasma cells that secrete antibodies. Other descendants can become memory B cells.
Icons show one selected interaction rather than all required signals, and are not to scale.
Recall: Which activated B-cell descendant secretes antibodies? Plasma cells secrete antibodies.

recall.question: Which activated B-cell descendant secretes antibodies?
